items.decision_title: Use hybrid retrieval for thesis experiments
items.decision_statement: Use hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense, RRF k = 60) for every thesis experiment.
items.decision_rationale: Two papers report consistent gains over dense-only on NQ and TriviaQA, largest under distribution shift.
items.claim_statement: Hybrid retrieval outperforms dense-only retrieval on open-domain QA
items.reason: Varga & Chen 2024 find no gain from hybrid retrieval over a tuned dense retriever on HotpotQA. Your thesis experiments include multi-hop questions (D-05 proposes adding the HotpotQA split), so the decision may not hold for part of the evaluation.

previous_evidence.source_title: Fusion Retrieval Revisited: BM25 + Dense on Open-Domain QA

passage.passage: Table 2 reports the main results on Natural Questions. With reciprocal rank fusion (k = 60), the BM25 + dense fusion raises top-20 accuracy on NQ from 78.4 to 82.5, a gain of 4.1 points over the dense-only baseline.
passage.quote: the BM25 + dense fusion raises top-20 accuracy on NQ from 78.4 to 82.5

passage.passage: Table 3 summarises retrieval accuracy on in-domain and shifted test sets. Combining BM25 with the dense retriever improves top-20 accuracy over the dense-only baseline on both Natural Questions (+3.6) and TriviaQA (+2.9), with the largest gains on the shifted BEIR subsets. We attribute most of this gain to lexical matching of rare entity names that the dense encoder under-represents.
passage.quote: Combining BM25 with the dense retriever improves top-20 accuracy over the dense-only baseline on both Natural Questions (+3.6) and TriviaQA (+2.9), with the largest gains on the shifted BEIR subsets.

passage.passage: The hybrid configuration from Section 2.2 does not improve over our tuned dense retriever on HotpotQA, suggesting lexical signals matter less for multi-hop questions. Overall, on HotpotQA our tuned dense retriever is within 0.5 points of the hybrid configuration across all retrieval budgets.
passage.quote: on HotpotQA our tuned dense retriever is within 0.5 points of the hybrid configuration
